entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, agent ID 401. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I need to return something. My VeloBand. I'm just so confused by the whole process.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Oh, no, it's not broken. I just... it's not what I thought. I meant to send it back sooner, but we had a family emergency. It's been a nightmare.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can see you received the item 17 days ago. Can you tell me a bit more about what happened that prevented the return?

My son had to be rushed to the hospital. He needed an emergency surgery, and on top of that, my husband's deployment got moved up. It's just been me handling everything. I didn't even think about this band. Can't you just help me?
That sounds incredibly stressful. I'm so sorry you had to go through all of that. Let me pull up your account and check the policy for you. One moment.
Okay, thank you for waiting. I've reviewed your order, and I see it was delivered 17 days ago. According to our return policy, you are well within the 90-day window for a full refund.
Oh! Really? 90 days? The website was so confusing. That's a huge relief. Thank you so much.

You're very welcome. It's no problem at all. I am processing the return for you now and I've just sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it at any post office.
Wow, okay. That's so much easier than I thought it would be. Thank you, Diana. You've been a great help.
It was my pleasure. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope things get easier for you and your family. Have a good day.
